doc.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015

title: Jazz parties in Odessa and Denver
summary: Ruth and Bucky recall jazz parties in Texas and Denver and the musicians who attended.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans

blocks.x: Like ASCAP or whatever it is. So Ruth, did you get to go on these jazz party things? Did you want to?
Odessa and Midland. It’s the same one.
We had a lot of friends and we always had a good time. Very nice. We went a long time.
Denver. They made that movie that we watched.
That was an incredible assemblage of musicians.
Yeah, Ruby Braff starts it off, doesn’t he?
Yeah. And was there people like, let’s say Phil Woods. If Phil Woods came to that thing would you guys be saying he’s a little modern for this.
No I wouldn’t say that. The way he played, that was great.
